sources.role: upstream build, XDG, and platform documentation

paths.path: ~/.config/linapple/linapple.conf after user-local install; use a private copied file for an adapter launch.
paths.naming: Registry INI sections and key=value lines; source defaults to res/linapple.conf when installed.

paths.path: linapple.conf keys Joystick 0/1, Joystick 0/1 Index, Button 1/2, Axis 0/1, and Joystick Exit Enable/Button 0/1; SDL joystick values use runtime enumeration indices.
paths.naming: joyinfo modes 0=none, 1=SDL joystick, 2/3=keyboard, 4=mouse; no persistent GUID/name selector.

paths.path: Guest saves are written inside attached Apple II disk images (.dsk/.do/.po/.2mg/.hdv) selected by the launch arguments.
paths.naming: Guest/emulated-OS-defined filenames inside user-owned media; no universal LinApple game-save sidecar.

paths.path: SaveState.aws by default; quick slots use SaveStateN.aws in the current working directory unless an explicit snapshot filename is supplied.
paths.naming: AppleWinSnapshot binary with source tag/version checks; .aws extension.

paths.path: Built-in Apple II system/peripheral ROMs are compiled into the selected build; -R/--rom accepts a custom system ROM file.
paths.naming: Custom ROM must be at least APPLE2_ROM_SIZE and no more than 65536 bytes; no universal external BIOS filename/checksum.
No external cryptographic key file is documented.
